remediation_phases.name: Immediate Mitigation
remediation_phases.description: Add LP_CODE auth guard to asset endpoint; change Cache-Control to private, no-store; add X-Content-Type-Options; purge CDN cache

founder_decisions_required.question: Single-user LP_CODE mode vs. future multi-tenant: must the current architecture be backward-compatible with a multi-tenant migration, or is a clean-break migration acceptable?
Project Delete: when a project is deleted, should its R2 assets be deleted immediately, soft-deleted with a retention period, or access-revoked but data retained?
Export: does export require a separate permission tier, or does any LP_CODE holder who can access a project have export rights?

Share feature: if a user shares a canvas, does the share link (a) require the recipient to authenticate with LP_CODE, (b) generate a separate temporary-public URL for the shared canvas assets, or (c) embed assets inline in the share export?
Public mode: is there any use case where assets should be publicly cacheable (e.g., a public portfolio mode)? If yes, this requires explicit architecture decision separate from LP_CODE mode.
